faq.q: How much does Pines Salomon Personal Injury Lawyers charge?
faq.a: Pines Salomon Personal Injury Lawyers publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Pines Salomon Personal Injury Lawyers offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Pines Salomon Personal Injury Lawyers publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Pines Salomon Personal Injury Lawyers have offices?
faq.a: Pines Salomon Personal Injury Lawyers publishes two offices, among them San Diego. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Pines Salomon Personal Injury Lawyers?
faq.a: Pines Salomon Personal Injury Lawyers names nine attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: California does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results Pines Salomon Personal Injury Lawyers publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Pines Salomon Personal Injury Lawyers publishes ten case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's.
